reference_extraction.rule: tei:text/tei:body document-order text; drop the subtree of every tei:note and tei:g (tails kept); tei:head kept; keep only U+3400-U+9FFF and U+F900-U+FAFF; one UTF-8 line, no trailing newline

note: Measurement of the task-043 reinstatement candidate (sessions/P1_CONGRONGLU_2026-09-20.json), run with the candidate staged at data/corpus/congronglu.json plus a 'congronglu' mapping in scripts/collate_corpus.py DOCS. Not a designation and not a corpus change: landing the document needs the owner's ruling on the evidence model (sessions/P1_CONGRONGLU_2026-09-20.md section 5).

content_denominator: source content fields only (commentary_zh, pointer_zh, verse_zh, zh); metadata fields (title_zh, name_zh) are measured separately and are not proof of collation
status_scope: Containment/remediation state, not a rights decision.

reference_verification.rule: statuses are byte-identity of the reference file against a named digest manifest; `drift` never rescues a claim and never upgrades one

notes: Field classes are computed from the reference text plus the harness variant map; a difference can come from the reference layer or from harness normalization, and each one is listed above rather than folded into a total.
